content:
Nadia P: Hi team — first-week question: I started 4/10 and there's a company holiday on 4/20. Am I eligible? Also, my dependent enrollment docs are still pending  will their coverage start the same day as mine or later? Lastly, I paid for temporary storage during my move  can I get reimbursed before payroll?
People Ops: Welcome Nadia! :tada: Holiday pay: if your hire was fully processed in payroll before the payroll cutoff for that run you should receive holiday pay. I'll ping payroll to confirm the exact cutoff timestamp for the 4/20 run.
FinanceBot: Automated note: payroll cutoff for April payroll: 2027-04-16 17:00 PT. New hire actions must be complete and in the system by that time to be included.
Eli S: Dependent coverage: depends on carrier processing. If you enrolled during onboarding, carriers often make coverage effective retro to your start date; if enrollment was late it may start on the 1st of next month. Email benefits@redwood.com with the dependent docs and we'll escalate to the broker.
Nadia P: Thanks — I did enroll during onboarding but uploaded the proof-of-dependent PDF yesterday (4/12). Should I re-send?
People Ops: If file was uploaded yesterday it may not have hit the broker feed yet. Please email the PDF to benefits@redwood.com with subject line "New hire dependent docs - Nadia P" and attach a brief note with your start date. We'll confirm and reply here once carrier confirms effective date.
Rita H: Re reimbursements: two options — 1) request a virtual Ramp card (can be issued same day once approved by People Ops) 2) submit an expense in Concur and request off-cycle reimbursement. Off-cycle reimbursement usually posts in 48-72 business hours after approvals. For urgent cash, request the virtual Ramp card and we can approve faster.
Nadia P: Got it. I prefer reimbursement directly — I'll file Concur now and email ops. One more q: does PTO accrual start day 1 or is it pro-rated monthly?
Eli S: PTO accrual begins on day 1 but visible balance on paycheck is prorated to the month. You can view projected accruals in the payroll portal under "Time off".
People Ops: Action items for Nadia: 1) Email benefits@redwood.com with dependent PDF (subject above) 2) File Concur expense for storage and email ops@redwood.com with the link + receipts to request off-cycle 3) Confirm W-4 + direct deposit are set in payroll portal. We'll update this thread when payroll confirms holiday eligibility.
Nadia P: Thank you all! Appreciate the clear steps :raised_hands:
